summary: Rows of a declared data collection (or stub). With a hook that opens a screen from that data, each row opens it.
label: optional
template: list "Items" from $data empty: "Nothing yet." -> opens screen "$rowScreen"

params.name: empty
params.description: Text shown when there are no rows

params.name: hook
params.description: opens screen "<row screen>" makes each row open it

data.reads: The rows this reader may read under the collection's read rule.

routes.purpose: rows; read: own gives a person only their rows, read: private gives everyone, the host included, only their own

permissions: The server filters rows by the read rule; the page never receives rows it may not show.
replaces: Per-user row filtering and list rendering.
